summary: Defines how MIDI music commands are carried in RTP packets over a network. It can encode anything that legally appears on a MIDI 1.0 DIN cable, so it works for live network music performance as well as streaming music files, over UDP or TCP, unicast or multicast.

eli5.summary: MIDI is how electronic instruments send notes to each other over a cable. This lets the same note messages travel across the internet instead, so musicians in different places can play together or stream music.

questions: how to send midi over rtp
